title: Maturation of the Infant Microbiome Community Structure and Function Across Multiple Body Sites
host_or_population: Human maternal–infant dyads; 81 prospective longitudinal dyads plus a matched cross-sectional delivery cohort
condition_or_phenotype: Pregnancy and early-life microbiome; delivery mode
body_sites: maternal stool|oral gingiva|nares|skin|vagina; infant stool|oral gingiva|nares|skin
study_design: Longitudinal to approximately 6 weeks plus cross-sectional delivery cohort
screening_notes: Article reports 2,581 collected specimens and 1,429 retained after quality filtering; enrolled 81 prospective dyads plus 81 matched cross-sectional gravidae, with 157 dyads sampled at delivery after exclusions. NCBI lists 1,928 BioSamples and 1,836 SRA Experiments; archive object counts are not interchangeable with article specimen counts. Sample-level source tables should be consulted before linking participant traits.

title: Mother-to-Infant Microbial Transmission from Different Body Sites Shapes the Developing Infant Gut Microbiome
study_design: Longitudinal sampling from birth to 4 months
screening_notes: Paper reports 25 dyads and 216 high-quality metagenomes in its analysis. NCBI currently lists 230 BioSamples and 230 SRA Experiments. curatedMetagenomicData provides profiles and metadata; check exact sample crosswalk and package version before reuse.

title: Mother-to-infant microbiota transmission and infant microbiota development across multiple body sites (MUIS)
host_or_population: 120 mother–infant dyads plus four additional mothers with partial sampling
condition_or_phenotype: Early-life microbiota transmission; birth mode and feeding
study_design: Infant sampling from birth to 1 month; mother–infant paired
screening_notes: The paper reports 2,453 samples across 120 pairs plus four mothers; the BioProject narrative says 2,319 samples, while the current NCBI project page lists 1,842 BioSamples and 1,842 SRA Experiments. The project notes that some reads were previously included under other BioProjects. Keep dyad and sample counts separate; deduplicate BioSample accessions across projects before calculating unique specimens.

title: Social and psychological adversity are associated with distinct mother and infant gut microbiome variations
condition_or_phenotype: Prenatal and early-life social disadvantage and psychological stress
study_design: Prospective dyad cohort; prenatal maternal and infant 4-month sampling
paired_or_longitudinal: paired; maternal prenatal and infant follow-up
screening_notes: Paper reports 121 dyads for 16S and WMS for 89 dyads. Supplementary Data 2 maps detailed sample metadata to SRA accessions and includes normalized abundance data. NCBI currently lists 458 BioSamples and 458 SRA Experiments; do not interpret 458 as participants.

title: Lifelines NEXT / MOM MATTERS longitudinal mother–infant cohort
host_or_population: 714 mother–infant pairs in the Lifelines NEXT Dutch birth cohort
condition_or_phenotype: Pregnancy and infant development; maternal smoking/hypertension, feeding, eczema and other phenotypes
study_design: Longitudinal from pregnancy through infant age 1 year
assays: shotgun metagenomic sequencing; additional 16S datasets in EGA
screening_notes: The 2026 paper reports 4,526 longitudinal fecal specimens from 714 pairs and says quality-trimmed, human-decontaminated SRA reads are public. EGA lists 4,577 records for fecal metagenomics/phenotype linkage; these may reflect a different release or record count and are not substituted for the paper count. Clinical/questionnaire metadata and selected reads require EGA/Lifelines application. EGA lists a separate 1,501-sample 16S fecal/milk dataset.

title: Human fecal shotgun metagenomes from public colorectal cancer studies: curated taxonomic, functional and metadata tables
host_or_population: Human stool cohorts across 10 countries; healthy controls, adenoma and colorectal cancer
study_design: Curated cross-cohort compilation of 15 public cohorts
screening_notes: Repository reports 2,340 stool samples across 15 cohorts/14 public BioProjects, with abundance/count tables and manually curated cohort metadata. Raw reads remain in originating archives. The dataset page identifies 104 samples flagged as contaminated for possible suppression and notes that metadata exclude samples lacking health status. Count is specimens, not necessarily unique participants across projects.

title: Colobiome: Tumour-adjacent microbiome
body_sites: tumour tissue swabs|adjacent healthy tissue swabs|stool
study_design: Tumour/adjacent tissue and stool sampling; patient pairing requires BioSample/metadata crosswalk
paired_or_longitudinal: multiple body sites; pairing not confirmed at row level in this pass
screening_notes: Archive description states 16S sequencing of tumour tissue swabs, adjacent healthy tissue swabs and stool; it lists 508 SRA Experiments and 508 BioSamples. This row records the Experiment count, not participants. Inspect sample attributes and paper supplements to recover exact patient pairing.

title: AC-ICAM colon cancer microbiome atlas
host_or_population: Human colon cancer cohort; 246 paired tumour/normal 16S patients, 42 additional tumour-only 16S samples, and a 167-patient WGS tissue subset
condition_or_phenotype: Colon cancer; clinical stage and tumour characteristics described in the paper
body_sites: primary tumour|matched adjacent normal colon tissue
study_design: Case-only paired tissue atlas with an additional tumour-only subset; multi-omics
paired_or_longitudinal: paired tumour-normal subset; sample identifiers encode patient and tissue labels
screening_notes: Paper reports AC-ICAM246 as 492 matched tumour/normal 16S specimens from 246 patients, plus 42 tumour-only 16S specimens; this row totals those 534 16S specimens. It separately reports 167 tumour WGS samples. Public SRA contains 16S; WGS/host sequencing access has controlled-access components. Do not treat WGS subset or total project patient count as the 16S sample count.

title: Tumour tissue-associated microbiome in colonic adenoma and carcinoma FFPE specimens (5R 16S)
host_or_population: Human colonic adenoma and carcinoma archival FFPE tissue specimens
study_design: Retrospective case-control across adenoma and carcinoma tissue
screening_notes: Paper reports 50 tissue specimens plus four sampling negative controls (54 SRA/BioSample records, confirmed on BioProject). Ten additional DNA-extraction/PCR controls are available on reasonable request, not in the open SRA deposit. Reported sample count excludes the four sampling controls. Check supplementary files for phenotype granularity.

title: Bacterial and viral communities in healthy and tumoral colorectal tissue by RNA and DNA deep sequencing
host_or_population: Human colorectal tissue from CRC and matched control patients
study_design: Matched case-control; 10 CRC and 10 matched control patients
paired_or_longitudinal: matched patient groups; exact specimen crosswalk to be audited
screening_notes: Paper reports 10 CRC patients and 10 matched control patients (20 participants); NCBI lists 40 BioSamples and 40 SRA Experiments, which are not interpreted as unique biological specimens. DNA and RNA deep-sequencing data are available as aligned non-human sequences. Detailed sample-to-assay and paired tissue crosswalk still needs supplement-level audit.

title: Public V4 16S CRC/adenoma/healthy stool cohorts reused in a cross-cohort study
host_or_population: Human stool cohorts from multiple published studies
study_design: Cross-cohort secondary analysis; four discovery projects plus two independent validation cohorts
screening_notes: Paper says four accessible V4 16S studies were downloaded from these archives and two additional projects were used as independent cohorts. This row indexes a secondary-analysis cohort set, not one project or unified patient-level table. No combined sample count entered because per-project counts and exclusions require supplement reconciliation.

title: Pooled analysis of 3,741 stool metagenomes from 18 colorectal cancer cohorts
host_or_population: Human stool cohorts; 18 cohorts across public and newly collected datasets
study_design: Pooled cross-cohort analysis; 12 prior public cohorts plus six newly collected cohorts
screening_notes: The article reports 3,741 total stool metagenomes from 18 cohorts: 2,116 samples from 12 previously public studies and 1,625 newly collected samples across six cohorts. Four new ONCOBIOME cohorts (PRJEB72524/72525/72526/72523), NHSII (PRJNA1237248), and cohort 6 (PRJNA1167935) have sequence deposits; MetaPhlAn 4/HUMAnN 3.6 profiles and metadata are in Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15069068. The total is not attributable to any one accession.

title: Diet–microbiome associations in 10,068 individuals from the Human Phenotype Project to guide personalized nutrition
host_or_population: Human Phenotype Project participants; Israeli cohort
condition_or_phenotype: Dietary exposures and gut microbiome associations; BMI and cardiometabolic phenotypes
study_design: Observational cohort; app-based diet logs; paper reports diet–microbiome associations over four years, exact repeated sample crosswalk not resolved
paired_or_longitudinal: Diet logs and gut metagenomes are analyzed together; current subject/sample/visit/Run mapping and repeated-measure linkage need verification
access_conditions: controlled_access|EGA DAC; additional HPP data by application and secure environment, non-commercial terms reported in paper
screening_notes: The 2026 paper reports analysis of 10,068 HPP participants with app-based diet logs and shotgun metagenomics and names EGAS00001007204 for individual-level gut metagenomes/basic phenotypes. Current EGA Study page lists associated Dataset EGAD00001010925 with 7,190 stool metagenomes and a legacy record title. Do not equate 10,068 participants with downloadable sequenced samples until the accession, cohort subset/freeze, and sample crosswalk are reconciled. Paper says other HPP datasets require application; confirm diet-log access separately. Code/Zenodo archive is not a data release.
